title: Control-Flow Complexity
proposition: Control-flow complexity describes the reasoning burden created by multiple interacting execution paths.
scope: Technology-neutral curriculum statement for V01-C12; CS2023 supports the competency scope and ECMAScript supplies one bounded normative example.
exceptions: Language-specific syntax and runtime behavior may differ; ECMAScript evidence is illustrative unless the claim explicitly names ECMAScript.
